For Brawley: Charleston 26; 101
Meetze: Lexington 6, Orangeburg 8,
Colleton 6, Berkeley 1. Total, 21.
The State Executive Committee in session, in Columbia, yesterday decided that where the same delegates in any counties had been elected to represent their counties in both the August and September Conventions, without the call of the County Convention having specifically stated it to be for that purpose, their election was invalid as to the September Convention, and elections would have to be ordered in such cases for delegates to that convention under the provisions of the constitution of the Democratic party. This order it is understood would effect the delegations in ten counties of the State.

This does not effect Lexington as the call left it optional with the delegates to the County Convention whether or not the delegates be elected to serve at both conventions. The convention elected them to serve at both conventions. But if necessary we will lay in three months rations and meet daily before the minority shall rule. The Tillmanites are here to stay, and please don't forget it in all your tactics, will you.
